index_line: - [[paradigm-persona-b]] — 8 Ω compatible but measures ~3.4 Ω min, sens 86.9 dB, 7" beryllium, NRC/HFN only, no spinorama
source_index_lines: - [[soundstage-paradigm-persona-b]] — SoundStage! review by Roger Kanno, 2017-12-01 (Tier D)
brand_notes: Persona B is flagship standmount, $5,249.99 each, beryllium drivers; maker only says 'compatible with 8 ohms' but measures ~3.4-3.8 ohm min. Prestige 15B (8-ohm compatible) is marked discontinued on Paradigm US site (mfr-paradigm-prestige-15b).
takeaways: Maker gives no nominal, only 'compatible with 8 ohms'; measured min 3.4 (NRC graph) / 3.8 (HFN) so flagged effectively-4ohm
NRC sensitivity 86.9 dB vs claimed 89 dB anechoic
HFN response error +/-4.6-4.8 dB, treble lift, presence dip; THD <=0.8% at 90 dB
SoundStage review is a rave; no spinorama or user reports
conflicts: Rave review vs uneven measured response
LF extension 42 Hz (HFN nearfield) vs NRC roll-off 75-80 Hz
